data.name: Master of Deception
data.description: A sandman gains a bonus [+%1] equal to half his level on Bluff, Sleight of Hand, and Stealth checks. He may also disarm magical traps with Disable Device as a rogue's trapfinding ability. This ability replaces bardic knowledge.|BardLVL/2
